主要内容: Brookfield Asset Management Inc. appointed Jay Cornforth as global head of its industrial property business. Cornforth will join Brookfield Property Group as a Managing Partner based in New York. He previously spent 10 years with Prologis and AMB, most recently serving as President of the east region responsible for 85 million square feet of operating assets across multiple U.S. locations. Brookfield Property Group announced its commitment to the industrial sector and the appointment of Jay to lead its growing industrial business. The company acquired Gazeley and Verde to expand its logistics and distribution facilities globally. Upon the acquisition of IDI, Brookfield will become one of the largest global owners of logistics facilities, with 62 million square feet of existing assets and 79 million square feet of future development potential. Brookfield Asset Management Inc. disclosed risks including changes in tax laws and other tax-related risks, as well as dependence on management personnel and operational risks. The company also mentioned the potential impact of catastrophic events such as earthquakes and hurricanes. These risks are detailed in documents filed with securities regulators in Canada and the United States. Securities explicitly mentioned in the source include BAM.
